summary: Chemomab Therapeutics filed a 6-K incorporating by reference sections of an effective Form S-4 for its previously announced July 7, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger with Snowdrift Parent Corporation, Snowdrift Sub Corp., Elderwood Ltd. and Scipher Medicine Corporation. The transaction involves Chemomab redomiciling into the U.S. (domestication) and Scipher becoming a wholly owned Chemomab subsidiary. The S-4, File No. 333-299153-01, was declared effective October 30, 2026. Disclosed financials include Scipher's audited 2025/2024 and interim June 30, 2026 statements, Chemomab's interim statements, and pro forma combined information. No price, stake, premium or close date is stated; watch shareholder approval and closing conditions.
